field_contract.surface_id: stable snake_case id for the catalog row
field_contract.track: owning swarm-control, swarm-scale, or swarm-autopilot track
field_contract.purpose: one sentence operator-facing reason this surface exists
field_contract.intent_tags: operator intents that should route to this surface
field_contract.symptom_tags: failure symptoms or queue states that should route to this surface
field_contract.required_inputs: named source artifacts or snapshots required by the surface
field_contract.emitted_artifacts: stable output artifacts produced by the surface
field_contract.implementation_script: repo-relative implementation script path, or null only when the row is contract-only and degraded
field_contract.smoke_script: repo-relative smoke script path, or null only when the row is contract-only and degraded
field_contract.owning_bead_id: bead that introduced or currently owns the surface
field_contract.upstream_surface_ids: surface ids that must be consumed or reviewed before this surface
field_contract.downstream_surface_ids: surface ids that are expected consumers
field_contract.mutation_policy: booleans proving advisory-only behavior and forbidden live mutations
field_contract.rch_policy: heavy validation command policy for examples and emitted command evidence
field_contract.source_freshness_policy: freshness windows and stale-source decisions for required sources
field_contract.operator_status_section: section name in scripts/swarm_operator_status_report.sh handoff, or null when not yet surfaced
field_contract.failure_reason_codes: stable reason codes that consumers must preserve
field_contract.validation_commands: commands that validate the row or its source surface
